messages.subject: Issue with gl.pcoa()
parts:
Hi,
I'm getting an error returned from gl.pcoa(). 
The read out is:

Starting gl.pcoa 
Processing genlight object with SNP data 
Performing a PCA, individuals as entities, loci as attributes, SNP genotype as state 
Error in p1/p2 : non-numeric argument to binary operator

I tried restarting my R session and just loading in dartR_2.0.4 and using the bandicoot.gl genlight.

gl.pcoa(bandicoot.gl)

But I get the same error.

Any ideas? I'm not proficient enough with R to go deep diving into the function to find out what that means.

R version 4.1.2 (2021-11-01)

All the best,
Deane.

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Issue with gl.pcoa()
parts:
Hi Deane,

I think is because you don't have all the packages installed. Owing to CRAN requirements and compatibility reasons not all functions of the package may run after the basic installation, as some packages could still be missing. Hence for a most enjoyable experience we recommend to run the function
gl.install.vanilla.dartR()
This installs all missing and required packages for your version of dartR.

After running this function please try again with gl.pcoa
Cheers,
Luis
